mutation_policy.source_entries: Append new entries only; do not rewrite prior source entries in place.
mutation_policy.supersession: Append a new supersession entry whose supersedes_entries references prior entry IDs.
mutation_policy.expiration: Append a new expiration entry whose expires_entries references prior entry IDs, unless the expiration was known when the original entry was created.
mutation_policy.generated_views: HTML and report views may derive current-active, superseded, or expired status from later entries.
